name: Pathfinder
description: Scans the level, searches for a surviving path with a deterministic physics simulator, and only clicks when the click is proven to survive.

issues.info: Report bugs with the HUD note and the level id

enabled.name: Auto-play
enabled.description: Let Pathfinder drive the cube. Toggle this off to take back control.

plan-horizon-frames.name: Search horizon (frames)
plan-horizon-frames.description: How far ahead the simulator looks. 240 frames = 4 seconds. Higher = safer but slower.

min-secured-frames.name: Secured horizon (frames)
min-secured-frames.description: Stop searching once a plan this long provably survives.

click-horizon-frames.name: Click survival check (frames)
click-horizon-frames.description: A press is only allowed if the simulator proves at least this much survival afterwards.

replan-every-frames.name: Re-plan interval (frames)
replan-every-frames.description: Re-run the search from the live state this often. Lower = more responsive, more CPU.

max-states-per-frame.name: State budget per frame
max-states-per-frame.description: Cap on how many distinct player states the search keeps per frame. Lower this if you get frame drops.

verify-plans.name: Verify every plan
verify-plans.description: Replay each plan through the simulator before trusting it. Costs nothing and catches model drift.

gravity.name: Physics: gravity
gravity.description: Units per frame^2. Only change this if you are calibrating against a new GD version.

jump-velocity.name: Physics: jump velocity
jump-velocity.description: Units per frame at jump start. Stock GD cube value is 11.180032.

hitbox-blocks.name: Physics: hitbox size (blocks)
hitbox-blocks.description: Player hitbox in blocks. Stock GD is 1.0; the hazard hitbox is smaller than this.
